p: two hundred and eight, as it is stated: “And the multitude [verov] of his sons.” … But … the numerical value [gimatriyya] of … verov equals two hundred and fourteen,

two hundred and eight, as it is stated: “And the multitude [verov] of his sons.” The numerical value of the word verov equals two hundred and eight, alluding to the number of his sons. The Gemara comments: But in fact, the numerical value [gimatriyya] of the word verov equals two hundred and fourteen,
